title: Dashboard Overview Tour
description: Guided walkthrough highlighting key tenant posture widgets and security metrics.

steps.title: Tenant Overview
steps.content: View verified domains, directory synchronization state, and the latest assessment date.

steps.title: Key Metrics Grid
steps.content: At-a-glance pass, fail, and review counters across all evaluated controls.

steps.content: Headline posture score and pass/fail summary from the most recent assessment run.

steps.title: Security Alerts
steps.content: Distribution of open critical, high, medium, and low security alerts.

steps.title: Microsoft Secure Score
steps.content: Track Microsoft Secure Score percentage and benchmark comparison.

steps.title: Authentication Methods
steps.content: Analyze passwordless, phishing-resistant, Authenticator app, and legacy auth usage.

steps.title: MFA Adoption
steps.content: Monitor multi-factor authentication registration and enforcement rates.

steps.title: License Utilization
steps.content: Identify assigned versus purchased seats and license waste across top SKUs.
